title: QA verification harness — executed-behavior gates from spec to production

acceptance_criteria.given: a spec.json without acceptance_criteria
acceptance_criteria.then: the spec stays valid

tests.name: accepts a spec without acceptance_criteria

acceptance_criteria.given: a criterion without given, when, or then, or with a duplicate id
acceptance_criteria.then: it emits SPEC_CRITERIA_INVALID

tests.name: emits SPEC_CRITERIA_INVALID when a criterion lacks given, when, or then
emits SPEC_CRITERIA_INVALID for a duplicate criterion id

acceptance_criteria.given: a criterion command that exits 0
acceptance_criteria.when: a named test is missing from the output
acceptance_criteria.then: the criterion is unconfirmed and does not pass

tests.name: passes a criterion only when the command exits 0 and every named test is confirmed
marks a criterion unconfirmed when the command exits 0 but a named test is missing from the output

acceptance_criteria.given: trusted evidence pinned to an older commit
acceptance_criteria.then: it fails with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_STALE

tests.name: fails with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_STALE when evidence is pinned to an older commit

acceptance_criteria.given: a marker comment from an author outside the trusted associations
acceptance_criteria.then: it fails with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_UNTRUSTED

tests.name: fails with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_UNTRUSTED when only an untrusted author posted the marker

acceptance_criteria.given: an evidence payload that does not decode
acceptance_criteria.then: it fails closed with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_INVALID

tests.name: fails closed with CRITERIA_EVIDENCE_INVALID when the payload does not decode

acceptance_criteria.given: criteria verification running inside review-pr
acceptance_criteria.when: the conductor phase list is read
acceptance_criteria.then: the six phases keep their order

tests.name: declares the six pipeline phases in order

acceptance_criteria.given: a quality tool that declares paths
acceptance_criteria.when: no changed file matches those paths
acceptance_criteria.then: the tool does not run and the report shows not_triggered with an info verdict

tests.name: keeps a path-triggered tool only when a changed file matches its paths
reports not_triggered with an info verdict for an unmatched path-triggered tool

acceptance_criteria.given: a changed file under critical_paths
acceptance_criteria.then: the test plan of every component runs

tests.name: adds every component test plan to the fast profile when a changed file matches critical_paths

acceptance_criteria.given: a Stryker report with mutants on changed and unchanged lines
acceptance_criteria.then: the score counts only mutants on changed lines

tests.name: scores only mutants on changed lines as detected divided by valid times 100

acceptance_criteria.given: the consumer workflow templates
acceptance_criteria.then: every action is pinned to a full commit SHA and contents permission is read-only

tests.name: pins every action in every workflow template to a full 40-character commit SHA
declares top-level permissions with contents read in every workflow template

acceptance_criteria.given: a failing http smoke check
acceptance_criteria.then: it retries 3 times with backoff and exits 1

tests.name: smoke: retries an http GET check 3 times with 2, 4, and 8 second backoff
smoke: exits 1 when any smoke check fails

acceptance_criteria.given: the shipped templates, docs, and rule floor
acceptance_criteria.then: no file mentions regression_paths or verification_commands

tests.name: no template, doc, or rule-floor file mentions regression_paths or verification_commands

acceptance_criteria.given: a push whose fast quality profile exits 1
acceptance_criteria.then: the push is blocked

tests.name: pre-push: blocks the push when the fast profile exits 1

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request whose spec has a failing criterion
acceptance_criteria.then: it reports BLOCKED and the conductor stops before local-attest

tests.name: review-pr: a failing criterion reports BLOCKED and stops the conductor before local-attest

acceptance_criteria.given: criterion output that contains a secret and exceeds the size limits
acceptance_criteria.then: the output is redacted before it is truncated to 40 lines and 2000 characters

tests.name: truncates each output tail to 40 lines and 2000 characters after redaction

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request whose attestation reports every required leg passing
acceptance_criteria.when: that attestation was produced under a local-attest configuration the base ref does not have
acceptance_criteria.then: the merge gate returns ATTESTATION_CONFIG_CHANGED rather than a pass

tests.name: reports ATTESTATION_CONFIG_CHANGED when the matrix that ran is not the base branch's

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request that has been attested more than once
acceptance_criteria.when: the merge gate reads the attestation comments
acceptance_criteria.then: every attestation is a posted, unedited comment, so the second one is trusted too

tests.name: POSTs a new comment and minimizes the older one instead of editing it
accepts two successive attestations, which the old upsert model could not produce

acceptance_criteria.given: conductor-mode and standalone invocations of /pre-pr
acceptance_criteria.then: conductor mode names --profile fast and standalone still names --profile pr

tests.name: pre-pr: conductor mode runs the fast quality profile
pre-pr: standalone still runs the PR quality profile

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request that edits a governed file, in a repository whose base ref enforces attestation
acceptance_criteria.then: the attestation state is explicit with a warning naming the files and no blocking attestation reason, and a valid attestation is never reported verified

tests.name: reports the explicit state rather than blocking
never lets evidence authorize a pull request that edits a governed file

acceptance_criteria.given: a matrix run whose lint and test legs passed at the current commit on a clean tree
acceptance_criteria.when: dotbabel quality check runs with --reuse for those capabilities
acceptance_criteria.then: it runs none of those tools, still evaluates the coverage rules from the report the leg wrote, and marks each reused result with its leg and commit

tests.name: runs no tool the matrix already ran at this exact commit
still evaluates the coverage rules, from the report the leg wrote
marks every reused execution with the leg and commit it came from

acceptance_criteria.given: a run manifest that cannot be proven to describe the current tree
acceptance_criteria.then: the tool runs itself and the refusal reason is reported, and a changed report costs only the capability that reads it

tests.name: for a manifest that belongs to a different commit
for a dirty working tree
for a leg that did not pass
decides per capability: a tampered report costs coverage its reuse but not lint

acceptance_criteria.given: a repository whose .dotbabel.json enforces attestation but whose local-attest configuration cannot work
acceptance_criteria.then: it fails and names the consequence for a missing config, an ungoverned config, or an unknown required leg, and it never executes an executable config in a repository that is not trusted

tests.name: fails with NO_CONFIG when nothing can produce evidence
fails with CONFIG_UNGOVERNED when the config file is outside governance_files
fails with REQUIRED_LEG_UNKNOWN naming a required leg no matrix entry provides
does not load an executable config when execution is not permitted
does not execute the repository's config when the repository is not trusted

acceptance_criteria.given: a .dotbabel.json whose governance_files carries an entry with shell metacharacters or a path that escapes the repository
acceptance_criteria.then: no such entry reaches a shell command line, and it is hashed as absent so it can never match the gate's hash

tests.name: never puts a governance path into a shell command line
refuses anything that could escape the repository or reach a shell

acceptance_criteria.given: an open pull request whose current head may have a review-complete comment and a passing attestation
acceptance_criteria.when: the conductor derives its entry phase
acceptance_criteria.then: an attestation alone never skips the review stage, a review alone resumes at local-attest, both stop, and evidence for another commit or from an untrusted author counts for nothing

tests.name: never derives a terminal phase from an attestation alone
resumes at local-attest when the review already finished on this head
stops only when the review and the attestation both name this head
reports REVIEW_STALE, naming both commits, when a trusted comment names another head
reports REVIEW_UNTRUSTED for a non-owner and for an edited comment

acceptance_criteria.given: a pull request whose review stage may or may not have finished
acceptance_criteria.then: it posts only with a trusted receipt, no open finding thread, and no blocking criteria reason, refuses on anything unreadable, and re-reads the head before posting

tests.name: posts nothing without a post-pr-review receipt
posts nothing while a finding the review posted is still unresolved
posts nothing while the criteria check has a blocking reason
fails closed when reviews, threads or ancestry cannot be read
refuses to post when the head moved while it was gathering

acceptance_criteria.given: an agent that would write the review-complete marker, its payload line, or the post-pr-review receipt by hand
acceptance_criteria.when: the PreToolUse guard sees the command
acceptance_criteria.then: it blocks the command and names every sanctioned writer, while the writers and the ordinary finding marker still pass

tests.name: guard-criteria-evidence: denies a gh command that writes the review-complete marker
guard-criteria-evidence: denies the post-pr-review receipt marker
guard-criteria-evidence: the block message names every sanctioned writer
guard-criteria-evidence: allows the sanctioned review-complete writer and the receipt script
guard-criteria-evidence: still allows the idempotency marker on an ordinary finding
